title: Dataset
description: An immutable snapshot of a curated set of files (images or annotations) selected for downstream use (annotation, model training). It references a manifest file that lists the members and links to the DatasetQuery that produced it. The dataset references file URIs; it does not copy blobs.

id.description: Body id (mirrors the metaEnvelope id on the canonical)

schemaVersion.description: Semver of this record's own shape

recordedAt.description: When this record was written, as distinct from when the thing it describes happened

supersedes.description: w3ds:// reference to the record this one replaces

deleted.description: Soft-delete marker; the envelope itself stays, because W3DS has no delete

name.description: Dataset name as the person typed it

kind.description: Whether the manifest lists image files or annotation files

queryRef.description: Reference to the DatasetQuery envelope whose criteria produced this snapshot (kept separately so the same criteria can be re-run later to pull more data). May be a bare envelope id or a w3ds:// ref.

manifestRef.description: w3ds:// reference to the manifest file (a table of the member files). Content-addressed via manifestSha256.

manifestUrl.description: Convenience direct URL to the manifest file, if published.

manifestSha256.description: SHA-256 hex of the manifest content — pins the snapshot for reproducibility.

fileCount.description: How many files the manifest lists

observationCount.description: How many observations the member files carry

annotationCount.description: How many annotation records the member files carry

annotationFiles.description: References to the annotation files belonging to this snapshot

observationRefs.description: Envelope ids of the observations this snapshot was built from

frozen.description: The snapshot is sealed: its member list will not change again

producedBy.description: eName of the service that produced the snapshot, when a service rather than a person made it

createdBy.description: eName of the person who saved the dataset.
